messages:
June: Quick heads-up - noticed a broken anchor on the Runtime guide (anchors jump to empty section). Happens on prod and staging. Anyone have recent edits? :confused: Ravi: Hmm I touched that doc yesterday for the batch-sizing note. Which anchor specifically? June: the in-page link `#kv-cache-tips` goes to top of page instead of the fragment. URL: /kb/runtime/optimizations#kv-cache-tips Nina (Docs): That sounds like an anchor id rename happened during the last MDX clean-up. I can grep for the heading change. Ravi: I grepped quickly: `rg "kv-cache" content/ -n` shows the heading was renamed to "KV cache: best practices" which changed the slug to `kv-cache-best-practices`. June: ok that explains it. Solution options: 1) re-add the old anchor as an explicit html id, 2) add a redirect mapping for the fragment, or 3) update callers. Which do we prefer? Theo: For immediate fix, adding an explicit id on the heading is lowest-risk. Longer term we should update callers. Nina (Docs): Agree. I'll open a tiny PR that adds `

KV cache: best practices

` above the heading so old links keep working. Also will add a comment in the markdown about the slug change. kb-bot: scanned 72 pages for orphan fragments; created ticket KB-3010 (severity: med) and flagged 6 hits linking to `#kv-cache-tips`. Ravi: If Nina opens the PR, can someone do a quick pass to update internal references to the new slug too? I'll sweep the codebase after PR merges. June: @Ravi can you check examples in runtime-examples and onboarding? Those were the places I saw the jump behavior. Ravi: Will do after lunch. ETA ~2h. I'll post any extra refs here. Nina (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5999 - tiny patch adding id + inline comment. Tagging @docs for review. Theo: Pinged docs team for quick review. If CI green, please canary to staging docs next deploy window? Nina (Docs): Yep will request staging canary. deploy-bot: staging deploy queued for branch fix/kv-anchor by Nina. June: Quick QA checklist for staging: click from handbook TOC, run search for the fragment link, and check deep links from onboarding email template. Ravi: Spotted one more place in `internal-playbooks/deploys.md` referencing the old anchor. I'll open a follow-up PR to update to `#kv-cache-best-practices` across the repo after this merges. Nina (Docs): Thanks. I'll merge once CI passes and confirm staging canary results. If all good, we roll to prod tomorrow 10:00 PT. June: Appreciated. Small fixes like this keep the docs friction low. :raised_hands:
